Players Committee card image of [[Blaster Rack (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, may deploy a matching weapon on your unique (•) character present at a site from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/blasterrack.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4 a5142dd] (12 May 2020). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
